reconciled_capability.top_flux_forcing: Already exercised in DYN0A and supported by serialized Reference forcing.
reconciled_capability.distributed_prescribed_root_sink: Serialized Reference forcing contains root_extraction_sink(numnod), but existing purpose evidence keeps it zero and the standard LARE research runner has no distributed sink term.
reconciled_capability.variable_grid_reference: Existing research tooling can materialize fixed arbitrary vertical grids; C5N provides an R512/R1024/R2048 plus temporal-control qualification pattern.
reconciled_capability.conclusion: A new surface-flux-only blind discriminator needs no new production physics. Free-running ET/root-uptake prediction would need a separately qualified sink-feedback contract and must not be inferred from a prescribed-sink experiment.
reconciled_capability.free_drainage_reference_floor: NOT_ADMITTED: frozen run_reference_floor_sample admits only bottom modes 2 and 5; C6M run 35531511964 was rejected before solver execution.
reconciled_capability.surface_reference_repair: Use admitted bottom_mode 5 with bottom head held at each history's initial uniform equilibrium pressure head; surface top-flux perturbation remains the only time-varying boundary forcing.

physical_design.bottom_head_rule: Hold bottom head at the initial uniform equilibrium pressure head h0 for the full history.

rationale: The frozen Reference-floor API does not admit free drainage; the first C6M attempt exposed this authority boundary before any surface solve executed.
Holding the initial equilibrium bottom head fixed keeps the lower boundary time-invariant while the only perturbation originates from the surface.
Bottom exchange remains free to respond, so storage/profile and exchange propagation can be measured without a lower-boundary forcing event.
Using both B01 and B14 prevents a single-material minimum dimension from being treated as general.
SURF.interpretation_boundary: Comparator-relative surface-driven fixed-head evidence only. It is not free-drainage/recharge acceptance and no observed error becomes an application threshold.

ROOT_ET.prerequisite: After SURF architecture is exercised, derive and qualify a conservative distributed-source mapping plus a free-running root-uptake feedback contract.
ROOT_ET.prescribed_sink_limit: A prescribed Reference sink replay can isolate hydraulic propagation under identical extraction, but cannot establish that the ROM predicts stress-dependent root uptake or ET.

LONG_HORIZON.prerequisite: Surface/reference and source/sink semantics must first be stable.
LONG_HORIZON.minimum_horizon_requirement: Longer than the current sub-day/one-day laboratories; exact duration must be selected independently of candidate response.
LONG_HORIZON.caveat: Mass ledger closure is an integrity gate, not a water-partition fidelity criterion.

C6M_preregistration_basis.fresh_history_rule: History schedules and top-flux multipliers must be frozen before any C6M Reference generation and must not reuse C4-C6 responses for selection.

stop_rules: Do not infer ET/root-uptake predictive fidelity from prescribed sink replay.
Do not use the 16x10-cm control as continuum authority for the new surface-driven purpose.
Do not introduce top-focused partitions after seeing SURF response; any future new partition requires a separate preregistered representation work unit.
Do not select absolute hydrological tolerances from C6M/SURF errors.
Do not reopen C6J/BEMR/FEMO under the purpose-validation label.
No performance screen before a purpose-specific hydrological gate closes.
Do not interpret the C6M fixed-head surface laboratory as free-drainage or regional recharge validation.

next_authority.question: Do fresh source-free, fixed-initial-head, surface-flux histories have a numerically qualified high-resolution Richards hierarchy suitable for later purpose-specific Layer-ROM comparison on B01 and B14?
